evidence: backend/servers/reality-server/src/util/url_validator.rs:145-165 — Host::Ipv6 arm only rejects is_loopback()/fc00::/7/fe80::/10; IPv4-mapped IPv6 (::ffff:a.b.c.d) slips through the v4 blocklist since Ipv6Addr::is_loopback matches ::1 only and fc00/fe80 masks never match mapped addrs. Two SSRF sinks depend on this validator (agency_imports.rs:238, :290). PROMOTED to plan this run.
verified during Phase 3.5 adversarial pass: file+line references resolve; no existing test covers ::ffff:127.0.0.1 or ::ffff:169.254.169.254 (would fail on main).

backend/servers/reality-server/src/routes/sso.rs:148-151 — check_redirect_uri_allowed treats raw.starts_with("/") && !raw.starts_with("//") as unconditionally allowed; the backslash variant /\evil.com bypasses the protocol-relative check even though browsers normalize \ to /.

backend/servers/api-server/src/services/push_fanout.rs:280,773 — reqwest::Client::builder()...build().expect(...) on a Result that can fail (TLS init). Panics the fanout worker on transient TLS backend startup failure.

backend/servers/reality-server/src/routes/agent_reviews.rs:190-266 — create_review validates only rating (1..=5) then binds data.body into INSERT with no length/trim/non-empty check. Enables arbitrary-size review persistence + empty-body reviews from any authenticated caller.
